questions.Description: Study of Safety measures and Good Laboratory Practices in micro biology Laboratory

To study the Introduction, operation, precautions and use of common microbiology laboratory instruments: Incubator, pH meter, Hot air oven, Autoclave, Colorimeter, Laminar air flow hood, Clinical centrifuge.
To examine the Bacteria, Fungi and Protozoa under Microscope.
A septic Technique and media preparation(Both solid and liquid).
To demonstrate Motility of the given bacterial culture by hanging drop method.
Determination of Antibiotic Sensitivity by Kirby-Bauer method
To stain the bacteria and examine it using a micro scope
To identify the bacteria by Grams Staining and examine it under the microscope
Study the identification and examination of the bacteria by Acid fast staining
To determine the packed cell value of a given blood sample.
Determine an individual blood type using antiserum and blood sample
To enumerate the number of RBC’s and  WBC’s present in1 mm3of  blood sample.
To identify pathogenic microorganisms by using high medium
To demonstrate Water quality test by Most Probable Number Method (MPN).
